mapper.sql: sys_user.id, sys_user.username, sys_user.email, sys_user.password, sys_user.salt, sys_user.phone, sys_user.avatar, sys_user.create_time AS ucreate_time, sys_user.update_time AS uupdate_time, sys_user.del_flag AS udel_flag, sys_user.lock_flag AS lock_flag, sys_user.tenant_id, sys_user.type, sys_user.nick_name, r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_desc, r.create_time AS rcreate_time, r.update_time AS rupdate_time, sys_user.organ_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_user sys_user LEFT JOIN sys_user_role AS sur ON sur.user_id = sys_user.id AND sur.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_role AS r ON r.id = sur.role_id WHERE sys_user.id = #{id}

SELECT sys_user.id, sys_user.username, sys_user.email, sys_user.password, sys_user.salt, sys_user.phone, sys_user.avatar, sys_user.organ_id, sys_user.create_time AS ucreate_time, sys_user.update_time AS uupdate_time, sys_user.del_flag AS udel_flag, sys_user.lock_flag AS lock_flag, sys_user.tenant_id, sys_user.type, sys_user.nick_name FROM sys_user sys_user
and sys_user.type = #{query.type}
and sys_user.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.username},'%')
and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = sys_user.id AND ur.del_flag = '0' AND ur.role_id = #{query.roleId})
ORDER BY sys_user.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "total", COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE sys_user.lock_flag = '0') AS "active" FROM sys_user sys_user
and sys_user.type = #{query.type}
and sys_user.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.username},'%')
and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = sys_user.id AND ur.del_flag = '0' AND ur.role_id = #{query.roleId})
